{{Quote|One Evocii dares call himself Huttsbane. He raids my holdings and hides in a swamp village.|[[Suudaa Nem'ro]]|<ref name="TOR:BC" />}}
"'''Huttsbane'''" was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Evocii]] and an enemy of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he resided in a village near [[Jiguuna]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Be careful, little bounty hunter. Huttsbane once blasted into other palace. Killed pile of captains--murdered a mighty Hutt!|[[Carnus]]|<ref name="TOR:BC" />}}
Detesting the Hutts' enslavement of his people, Huttsbane openly opposed [[Suudaa Nem'ro]] and the entire [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], even breaking into a palace and murdering an unnamed [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Nem'ro, believing the Hutts to be the rightful masters of the Evocii, dispatched an [[Hunter (individual)|aspiring]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] seeking sponsorship for the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], to track down Huttsbane and bring back his head.<ref name="TOR:BC" />

When the bounty hunter fought through hoards of Huttsbane's comrades in the village of [[Baratatta]] and confronted him, [[Baratatta Spirit-Leader|the village's Spirit-Leader]] attempted to break a compromise, explaining the Evocii's plight and appealing to the Hunter's sense of honor.<ref name="TOR:BC" />

{{GameDS}}
The hunter, however, followed through on the contract and killed Huttsbane, bringing his head before Nem'ro.<ref name="TOR:BC" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Here is the head of a fallen warrior. Nem'ro is a great fool. He will accept it as Huttsbane's. Now please, go.|The Spirit-Leader gives the Hunter the head of a fallen Evocii as a substitute for Huttsbane's|<ref name="TOR:BC" />}}
The player has the option of agreeing to the Evocii elder's compromise of allowing the hunter to take a head from another fallen Evocii instead of killing Huttsbane.<ref name="TOR:BC" />
